name: Togepi
description: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

moves.name: Growl
moves.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making the foe less wary. The target’s Attack stat is lowered.

moves.name: Charm
moves.description: The user charmingly stares at the foe, making it less wary. The target’s Attack is sharply lowered.

moves.name: Metronome
moves.description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates the brain into randomly using nearly any move.

moves.name: Sweet Kiss
moves.description: The user kisses the foe with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.description: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the foe into falling asleep on the next turn.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: The user compels the foe to keep using only the move it last used for three to seven turns.

moves.name: Follow Me
moves.description: The user draws attention to itself, making all foes take aim only at the user.

moves.name: Wish
moves.description: A self-healing move. The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP in the next turn.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life- risking tackle. It also damages the user by a fairly large amount, however.

moves.name: Last Resort
moves.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.description: The foe is scorched with an intense blast of fire. The target may also be left with a burn.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.description: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.description: An attack that works only on a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.

moves.name: Flash
moves.description: The user flashes a light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.description: The user hits with a punch that may lower the target’s Defense. It can also smash cracked boulders.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

moves.name: Shock Wave
moves.description: The user strikes the foe with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the foe with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Captivate
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.description: The user attacks with its head. It may make the foe flinch. To find Pokémon, hit trees.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

moves.name: Heal Bell
moves.description: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all the party Pokémon.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: The user catches the foe off guard and swaps the foe’s held item with its own.

moves.name: Magic Coat
moves.description: A barrier reflects back to the foe moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description: An attack move that cuts down the foe’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

moves.name: Signal Beam
moves.description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Last Resort
moves.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and rams the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Peck
moves.description: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

moves.name: Mirror Move
moves.description: The user counters the foe by mimicking the move last used by the foe.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Foresight
moves.description: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

moves.name: Present
moves.description: The user attacks by giving the foe a booby-trapped gift. It restores HP sometimes, however.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

moves.name: Future Sight
moves.description: Two turns after this move is used, the foe is attacked with a hunk of psychic energy.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. It may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Psycho Shift
moves.description: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.

moves.name: Lucky Chant
moves.description: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing the foe from landing critical hits.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk.
